Slide Show by Bill Stewart.

strings.#30:
SLIDESHOW (tm) will display a series of bitmap files, somewhat like a projector slide show.

Slide Show will use any Windows bitmap file(s) (.BMP) placed in the BITMAPS subdirectory.  Several sample bitmap files come with After Dark.  You can add your own bitmap files and remove any bitmaps you do not wish Slide Show to use.

Slide Show can be directed to use the bitmaps in any specified directory.  Click on the "Pictures.." button to specify a directory.

Since any Windows bitmap file can be used, 
you can easily make your company logo or 
other artwork into a custom screen saver with Slide Show.
